description: This Java source file implements the DefaultDittoJsonHandler class, which provides a JSON handler for creating JSON arrays and objects, with methods for handling different JSON value types and building JSON structures.

classes.name: DefaultDittoJsonHandler
classes.description: A JSON handler class for constructing JSON arrays and objects, implementing methods for starting/ending arrays and objects, and handling various JSON value types.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of DefaultDittoJsonHandler.

methods.name: startArray
methods.description: Initializes a new JSON array structure and returns an empty list of JsonValues.

methods.name: startObject
methods.description: Initializes a new JSON object structure and returns an empty list of JsonFields.

methods.name: endNull
methods.description: Sets the current JSON value to null.

methods.name: endBoolean
methods.description: Sets the current JSON value to a boolean (true/false).

methods.name: endString
methods.description: Sets the current JSON value to a string.

methods.name: endNumber
methods.description: Sets the current JSON value to a number, parsing the string to appropriate numeric type.

methods.name: endArrayValue
methods.description: Adds the current JSON value to the array being constructed.

methods.name: endArray
methods.description: Finalizes the JSON array, converting it into a JsonValue.

methods.name: endObjectValue
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: endObject
methods.description: Finalizes the JSON object, converting it into a JsonValue.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current JsonValue being constructed.
